text.2:4: And who believe in that which is revealed unto thee (Muhammad) and that which was revealed before thee, and are certain of the Hereafter.
text.2:118: And those who have no knowledge say: Why doth not Allah speak unto us, or some sign come unto us? Even thus, as they now speak, spake those (who were) before them. Their hearts are all alike. We have made clear the revelations for people who are sure.
text.5:50: Is it a judgment of the time of (pagan) ignorance that they are seeking? Who is better than Allah for judgment to a people who have certainty (in their belief)?
text.13:2: Allah it is Who raised up the heavens without visible supports, then mounted the Throne, and compelled the sun and the moon to be of service, each runneth unto an appointed term; He ordereth the course; He detaileth the revelations, that haply ye may be certain of the meeting with your Lord.
text.27:3: Who establish worship and pay the poor-due and are sure of the Hereafter.
text.27:82: And when the word is fulfilled concerning them, We shall bring forth a beast of the earth to speak unto them because mankind had not faith in Our revelations.
text.30:60: So have patience (O Muhammad)! Allah's promise is the very truth, and let not those who have no certainty make thee impatient.
text.31:4: Those who establish worship and pay the poor-due and have sure faith in the Hereafter.
text.32:24: And when they became steadfast and believed firmly in Our revelations, We appointed from among them leaders who guided by Our command.
text.45:4: And in your creation, and all the beasts that He scattereth in the earth, are portents for a folk whose faith is sure.
text.45:20: This is clear indication for mankind, and a guidance and a mercy for a folk whose faith is sure.
text.52:36: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they are sure of nothing!
